name: Tune the Balanced plan for gaming (laptop)
description: Keeps the Balanced plan (battery-friendly) but disables USB selective suspend and PCIe link-state power management on AC power — both can cause input-device hitches and GPU latency.
touches: powercfg: SCHEME_CURRENT\501a4d13-42af-4429-9fd1-a8218c268e20\ee12f906-d277-404b-b6da-e5fa1a576df5 (PCIe link state power management, AC) -> 0
